F.name: Flood
F.description: Inundation of normally dry land by overflow of water bodies, surface water accumulation, or backflow from drainage systems.

C.name: Cyclone
C.description: Intense tropical storm system with sustained winds exceeding 63 km/h, accompanied by heavy rain and storm surge.

L.name: Landslide
L.description: Rapid downslope movement of rock, earth, or debris triggered by rainfall, seismic activity, or slope instability.

W.name: Wildfire
W.description: Uncontrolled fire spreading through vegetation in forests, grasslands, or wildland-urban interface areas.

E.name: Earthquake
E.description: Sudden shaking of ground caused by seismic wave propagation following movement along geological fault lines.

T.name: Tsunami
T.description: Series of ocean waves with very long wavelengths generated by large-scale seafloor displacement, typically from submarine earthquakes.

H.name: Heatwave
H.description: Extended period of excessively hot weather, relative to normal conditions, often with high humidity causing dangerous heat index values.
